alt: The Scheduled for Anonymization page listing candidates with Last Used, Scheduled For and Days Remaining columns and Keep Record buttons
needs: MANUAL: a Vitay admin must grant data_retention_plugin to the docs firm and turn retention on (minimum period 3 months), and some candidates need last_initiated_at older than (period - 30 days). The docs firm candidates were created 2026-11-03 so none fall inside even the 90-day preview; backdating last_initiated_at needs a Rails console on staging. Keep the records retention_exempt=false but not past the cutoff, or the nightly job anonymizes them

alt: The Single Sign-On tab in Configuration with the SSO Connections, SCIM Provisioning and Members sections
needs: MANUAL: the docs firm has no Stytch organization (is_stytch_sso_enabled false), so the Single Sign-On tab is hidden. Needs a Stytch test organization linked to the firm, the root recruiter linked to a Stytch member, and a live stytch_session_jwt cookie in the capture context (the Stytch admin portal widgets render from it)

alt: The Support Mode banner across the top of the app with the Viewing as email, the countdown and the Exit Support Mode button
needs: MANUAL: the banner renders only when the recruiter-token JWT carries a server-signed imp claim (ImpersonationService.init), which only the admin app issues when a Vitay staff member starts Support Mode. The docs credentials can't produce one. To automate: a staff user starts Support Mode on Sarah Johnson in the staging admin app, and the spec accepts that token as an extra role (e.g. as "support" reading DOCS_TOKEN_SUPPORT) since it expires within 1-4 hours
